reviews.summary: Excellent Chinese quality but needs 32GB+ RAM. On 16GB Mac Mini, constant swapping. Quantised version loses the Chinese advantage.

positions.stance: Strong preference for local models. Cloud APIs are a dependency you don't control.
Most HK SMEs run 16GB Macs. Any tool that needs 32GB is not "free" — it costs HK$12,000+ in hardware.
Multilingual quality is the key differentiator for HK market. English-only tools miss half the use case.
